asked.item: Why Bluesky posts show Published but links open 'post not found' and nothing is on the profile
Whether this is caused by the connection (customer says connecting worked)

verdict.reason: The help sentences give no cause or fix for a post that shows Published in Blotato but is missing on Bluesky; the FAQ heading "My post shows 'published' but does not appear on the platform" appears only as a title with no answer text, and the connection and reconnect sentences do not address it.
